description: This Dart file defines the LocaleViewModel class, which manages locale state using ChangeNotifier for a Flutter app. It provides methods to load and set the locale, interacting with a LocaleRepository.

classes.name: LocaleViewModel
classes.description: A view model managing locale state, loading and updating locale information, and notifying listeners in a Flutter application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the current locale code from the repository and updates the locale property.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets a new locale, updates the repository with the locale code, and updates the locale property.
